# Vendored reference validator

`graph.gen.mjs` and `validation.gen.mjs` are copied unchanged from
[cognizant-ai-labs/agentic-web](https://github.com/cognizant-ai-labs/agentic-web)
(`skills/agentify-website/runtime/generated/`, commit 63a956c).
They are transpiled from `neuro_san/kernel/validation.py` and are the exact checks the
reference browser runtime runs before executing a network.

License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE.txt`). Do not edit these files; update them by copying
a newer version and re-running the test suite.
